title: The Illusion of Debiasing: Persona Steering Redistributes Rather Than Reduces Bias in LLMs
reasoning: The paper does evaluate bias across various demographic domains, including religion, using the BOLD dataset. It explores whether persona conditioning reduces social bias across closed-form QA (BBQ), open-ended generation (BOLD), and word association (WAT). However, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate faith, ethics, moral reasoning, or religion beyond using 'Religion' as one of the demographic categories in a broader study of social bias.
